summary: Iteration 2 focused retest of the desktop mega-menu bug fix on Barito Media Group PHP homepage plus a light regression check. All 5 mega-menu scenarios requested by main agent pass, and no regressions detected in carousel, mobile drawer, or outlet grid. Console/page errors: 0. Duplicate data-testid confirmed removed (nav-item count=1). One minor UX observation on click-toggle behavior interacting with hover state (non-blocking).

verified_scenarios.mega_menu_hover_opens_panel: PASS - panel visible=True at 1920x900, shows all 6 outlet links with logo+tagline
verified_scenarios.mega_menu_mouseleave_closes_after_150ms: PASS - visible=False after mouse moved away + 500ms wait
verified_scenarios.mega_menu_click_toggles: PASS (with note) - toggles open/closed correctly; because Playwright hover before click already sets menu-open, first click closes then next opens. On a real desktop user the hover path is primary so this is not user-visible, but on pure-click (e.g. keyboard focus without hover) the toggle works as expected (Test 5 confirmed a fresh click opened the panel).
verified_scenarios.escape_closes_menu: PASS - Escape key closes an open panel
verified_scenarios.outside_click_closes_menu: PASS - clicking (1500,500) outside nav-item closes panel
verified_scenarios.duplicate_testid_removed: PASS - document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="mega-menu-item"]') returns exactly 1 element (the inner div.nav-item)
verified_scenarios.regression_carousel: PASS - 3 dots, next advances to dot-1, prev returns to dot-0
verified_scenarios.regression_mobile_drawer_390: PASS - toggle opens drawer, close button removes .open class
verified_scenarios.console_and_page_errors: PASS - 0 console messages, 0 page errors during full flow

minor_observations: homepage.js mega-menu click handler uses classList.toggle. Because desktop 'mouseenter' already adds .menu-open before the click event fires (mouse must be over the button to click it), a click on the trigger while hovered will toggle the menu CLOSED. This does not affect touch (no hover) or keyboard focus (also no hover), and hover-out with 150ms close still works. If main agent wants the click to always OPEN when hovered-and-visible, the handler could set the class explicitly based on current state + hover intent rather than toggle. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: homepage.js click toggle vs. mouseenter interaction is a subtle UX quirk (see minor_observations). Suggest: track menuOpenedByHover flag or use explicit open()/close() based on current class rather than blind toggle when trigger is being hovered.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 requested mega-menu scenarios + regression checks pass)

test_credentials: not required for this homepage-only retest
